lessonTitle: 9. Adding natural numbers. The commutative law of addition — Practice
lessonTitleEnglish: Adding natural numbers. The commutative law of addition — Practice
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 5 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Compute 56 789 + 43 211.
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Each place adds up to 10 with the carry. 2. 100 000.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Each place adds up to 10 with the carry. 2. 100 000.

stages.headline: One addend is 2 358, the other 4 642. Find the sum.
stages.headlineEnglish: One addend is 2 358, the other 4 642. Find the sum.
stages.problemText: One addend is 2 358, the other 4 642. Find the sum.
stages.solutionSteps: 1. 2 358 + 4 642. 2. Every place makes 10 with the carry. 3. 7 000.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. 2 358 + 4 642. 2. Every place makes 10 with the carry. 3. 7 000.

stages.headline: A library had 12 450 books and bought 2 780 more. How many books now?
stages.headlineEnglish: A library had 12 450 books and bought 2 780 more. How many books now?
stages.problemText: A library had 12 450 books and bought 2 780 more. How many books now?

stages.headline: Two numbers add up to 500. One addend is increased by 25. What is the new sum?
stages.headlineEnglish: Two numbers add up to 500. One addend is increased by 25. What is the new sum?
stages.problemText: Two numbers add up to 500. One addend is increased by 25. What is the new sum?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. If an addend grows by 25, the sum grows by 25. 2. 500 + 25 = 525.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. If an addend grows by 25, the sum grows by 25. 2. 500 + 25 = 525.

stages.headline: A triangle has sides 13 cm, 25 cm and 17 cm. Find its perimeter.
stages.headlineEnglish: A triangle has sides 13 cm, 25 cm and 17 cm. Find its perimeter.
stages.problemText: A triangle has sides 13 cm, 25 cm and 17 cm. Find its perimeter.
stages.solutionSteps: 1. The perimeter is the sum of the sides. 2. 13 + 25 + 17 = 55 cm.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. The perimeter is the sum of the sides. 2. 13 + 25 + 17 = 55 cm.
